```{python}
from render import make_regression_table
from specs import (
    coal_shock,
    coal_shock_panel,
    fuel_shock,
    fuel_shock_panel,
    jobloss,
    palm_shock,
    palm_shock_panel,
    update_formula_search_replace,
)

main_shock_specs = [palm_shock, fuel_shock, coal_shock, jobloss]
panel_shock_specs = [palm_shock_panel, fuel_shock_panel, coal_shock_panel]
```


## Main Table

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Daily Mean

```{python}
make_regression_table(main_shock_specs)
```

### 7-day mean

```{python}
main_shock_7_day = [
    update_formula_search_replace(spec, "tmean_c_dev", "tmean_7d_dev")
    for spec in main_shock_specs
]
make_regression_table(main_shock_7_day)
```

### 7-day hot days

```{python}
main_shock_hot30_7_day = [
    update_formula_search_replace(spec, "tmean_c_dev", "hot30_7d_dev")
    for spec in main_shock_specs
]
make_regression_table(main_shock_hot30_7_day)
```


:::
